newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA M1 UP 7.36 PCT, M2 RISES 2.66 PCT IN WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA M1 UP 7.36 PCT, M2 RISES 2.66 PCT IN WEEK.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply rose to 156.1 billion levs on November 8 from 145.4 billion levs on November 1 and M2 edged up to 837.2 billion levs from 815.5 billion levs, reliminary central bank figures showed.

Total broad money rose by 2.69 percent to 871.1 billion levs as lev-denominated broad money edged up by 3.39 percent to 512.3 billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money rose 1.73 percent to 358.8 billion levs.
Hard currency-denominated deposits of companies and individuals totalled $1.324 billion on November 8, down $12 million from November 1.
Lev-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals inched up to 301.5 billion levs on November 8 from 297.6 billion levs a week earlier. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
